pr_title: net: fix for assert on enabling socket CAN
pr_body:
Socket CAN does not require interface link address to be
assigned, check is not applicable for socket CAN
interfaces. As this address is NULL for socket CAN interface
it results in assertion.

Fixes #37132

Signed-off-by: Ramesh Babu B <ramesh.babu.b@intel.com>
pr_comments: Can you add a check if the interface is of type SocketCAN?

> Can you add a check if the interface is of type SocketCAN?

ya sure. 

Condition check:
net_if_l2(iface) == &NET_L2_GET_NAME(CANBUS_RAW)
Looks alright to me, but why are so many CI checks failing? @rbabub are you looking at those and planning to fix them?
LGTM - please check the compilation errors @rbabub

> LGTM - please check the compilation errors @rbabub

ok sure.
All checks are passed, could you please review and provide approval.

issue_context.title: Assert on enabling Socket CAN
issue_context.body:
Assert while running socket can application seen during interface initialization.

ASSERTION FAIL [net_if_get_link_addr(iface)->addr != ((void *)0)] @ WEST_TOPDIR/zephyr/subsys/net/ip/net_if.c:3993

Flags added in prj.conf of socket can application,    CONFIG_ASSERT=y

**Expected behavior**
Socket CAN does not require interface link address to be assigned, above check is not applicable for socket can interfaces.
As this address is NULL for socket CAN interface it results in assertion.

**Logs and console output**
ASSERTION FAIL [net_if_get_link_addr(iface)->addr != ((void *)0)] @ WEST_TOPDIR/zephyr/subsys/net/ip/net_if.c:3993
[00:00:00.138,092] <err> os: Faulting instruction address (r15/pc): 0x6000f8bc
[00:00:00.146,820] <err> os: >>> ZEPHYR FATAL ERROR 4: Kernel panic on CPU 0
[00:00:00.155,334] <err> os: Current thread: 0x60081160 (unknown)
[00:00:00.162,841] <err> os: Halting system

Note:
This check was introduced part of commit id "1e4f268ea94066cfc60c80019cf515b2baafc167".
comments: @carlescufi we rather need a network stack expert here. Ping @rlubos
For me it looks like we need something like  `| (IS_ENABLED(SOCKET_CAN) && is_socket_can(iface))` in the assert
@rbabub can you make a PR with a fix?
ya sure, will check & submit the patch.

review_comments: @alexanderwachter There's `CANBUS_RAW_L2` and `CANBUS_L2` - should the LL address check be skipped for both or is the current solution enough?
RAW only. The other is 6loCAN, which is IPv6 over CAN. It has a 14bit address.
